verdict.rationale: Exporting data and leaving is a fair question for a data store like Elasticsearch, but the evidence pack documents no export capability: no snapshot, bulk export, or open-format dump. Deployment flexibility (self-managed or on-prem) and official client libraries are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not a documented export-in-open-formats capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
